Overview

Gastonia is a city in NC with a population of 78,000. Gaston County hub with the Schiele Museum and Crowders Mountain State Park. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
